question_text: What critical memory management defect commonly occurs in the classic Observer pattern when observers are dynamically registered but never unregistered?

options.text: Lapsed Listener leak (Subject maintains strong references preventing garbage collection of listeners)

answer_explanation: The subject retains strong references to observers in its subscription list. Even if caller references are dropped, the GC cannot collect observers, causing a Lapsed Listener leak.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: The subject retains strong references to observers in its subscription list. Even if caller references are dropped, the GC cannot collect observers, causing a Lapsed Listener leak.
